title: Migración a las ciudades
goal: Read how factory jobs pulled millions from the countryside into cities that couldn't build infrastructure fast enough, producing favelas, villas miseria, and barriadas across the region.

items: Explain who the new factories and public works attracted.
State how São Paulo's population changed between 1940 and 1970.
Describe the contradiction receiving cities faced.
Name the informal settlements that appeared across the region.
Use no dejar de + infinitive to describe a continuous, unstopping process.
